examples.rationale: Product is large, centered, high-contrast in frame one; the curiosity-gap caption reads instantly on a thumbnail.
Subject framed tight with a bold hook line; the opener scroll-stops for an already-engaged review format.
Opens on a slow empty room with no subject and no hook line — nothing stops the scroll for a cold-traffic ad.
The product is tiny and buried behind a logo card; subject visibility fails at thumbnail size.
A flashy opener that over-promises versus what the clip delivers — a misleading hook that tanks retention and trust.
The baked hook line is grey-on-grey and illegible on autoplay; a hook you cannot read is no hook.
